turns.customer: The Harbor double sleeping bag from order #1051 arrived with the zipper torn off. I'd like a refund.
turns.reply: We're so sorry your Harbor 3°C Double Sleeping Bag arrived with a damaged zipper. I've submitted a $179.99 refund request for the item — since it's over $50, a team member will review it, usually within one business day. I'll make sure you hear back with the result. No need to send the item back unless we ask. If there's anything else, just let me know.

message 1: get_policy({"topic":"refunds"}) → {"ok":true,"data":{"topic":"refunds","title":"Refunds","text":"Refunds go back to the original payment method.
A refund can never be more than what was paid for the order.
Our support team can issue refunds for damaged items, lost orders and late deliveries (shipping cost only). Refunds up to $50.00 per order are processed right away; larger amounts are reviewed by a team member, usually within one business day.
Damaged items are refunded per item, up to what was paid for that item. Items that cost more than $50.00 are always reviewed by a team member, whatever amount is requested.
Refunds for returned items are issued when the warehouse receives the return."}}
